scope: Exact stock OpenSSH SFTP publication acknowledgment loss and private read-only recovery

local_race_replay.environment: macOS ARM, real PostgreSQL 16.15, stock OpenSSH 10.5p1 SSH and SFTP server and stock SFTP client, protected HTTPS, no local inference
assertions: The same pinned stock SFTP server processed the publish hardlink and returned status OK for the exact request ID. The fixture saved only its digest and withheld that one response.

The independent final path existed and pointed to the original staging inode. The private delivery stayed ambiguous at the original attempt and fence. The same work key, a new work key and a wrong actor produced zero new receiver sessions.

The reviewed actor checked the original final path over a fresh stock SFTP session in read-only mode. Matching bytes recorded integrity with no new send or file sync claim. The original receipt replay made no connection.
An independent stock client read the exact file and confirmed the read-only daemon refused an attempted write. Both original links, the inode, mode and modification time remained intact.
The browser receiver-check replay, the stock post-publication worker death recovery and the full stock SFTP MCP collection-to-delivery path passed again.

remaining: Replay this exact fault profile on native x86 and ARM Linux. Broader SFTP endpoint, large file, multi-host and final qualification gates remain open.
